newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - United Auto cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - United Auto cut to hold.

text.p: -- ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Wednesday it lowered its rating on United Auto Group Inc to buy from hold as a result of the company's announcement of an earnings shortfall in the first quarter and management's inability to explain reasons for the expected down quarter during a conference call.
-- The company said it expected to report earnings in a range of $0.17 to $0.21 a share, well below the consensus forecast of $0.25, ABN AMRO said.
-- ABN AMRO lowered its first-quarter estimate to $0.19 from $0.26 and its fiscal 1997 estimate to $1.40 from $1.55.
-- United Auto Group operates franchised auto dealerships.
-- Its shares were down 4-7/8 Wednesday at 19-7/8.
